Context: F. Risk Allowance

## F. Risk Allowance  
1. Admissibility.-Granted to the following categories of employees:
2. (i) Those engaged in duties involving greater hazards or whose health is liable to be adversely affected progressively over a long period of time because of the particular avocation.
3. (ii) Sweepers/Safaiwalas engaged in cleaning of underground drains and sewer lines.
4. (iii) Those working in trenching grounds and Infectious Diseases Hospitals.
